answer: The summit index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 849 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the juniper. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the garden queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. A 140 account operation therefore ties up 12 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
